newspaper.headline: Old Laptops, New Problems
newspaper.lead: Many office laptops are now more than four years old. Dusty fans, weak batteries, and loose RAM are becoming routine complaints at the IT Workshop.

impact.good: Yesterday, the IT Workshop's new technician handled every ticket correctly. Employees were happy not to wait long.
impact.mixed: Yesterday, most tickets at the IT Workshop were solved, though some were handled wrongly. Pak Joko asked the new technician to read symptoms more carefully.
impact.bad: Yesterday, several complaints at the IT Workshop went unsolved and users came back with the same problem. The ticket queue is piling up.

tip.title: Tip: Swollen Batteries
tip.text: Laptop case lifting or touchpad hard to press? The battery may be swollen. Don't charge it; take it to a technician right away.

newspaper.classified: FOR SALE: Thermal paste, mini screwdrivers, and endless patience. Contact the spare parts store.

boss.title: Laptop Mountain
boss.intro: The workshop desk is piled with laptops and complaints. Tell apart what is broken, what is misused and what needs a specialist.
